set.body: PRD C-4. Five named fields, not a named vector of six. Deletes the need for eyesim's flatten_similarity_output machinery and its expand_vector_output string test. Note: canonical scanpath simplification (grouping/TDir/TDur/TAmp) is NOT implemented in eyesim's R and must be written from scratch.
set.title: MultiMatch over the alignment kernel, returning MultiMatchScore
